rows.source_ko: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliaryagencies and equivalent advisory agencies placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination, Directors, Department Heads, and Center Heads pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act,” and the division of duties.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Regulations on the Organization of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies, and matters necessary for their implementation, including the ranks and staffing quotas of auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Agency and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies and equivalent advisory agencies under the Director of Planning and Coordination, Directors, Department Heads, and Center Heads pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the Government Organization Act, and the division of duties.

rows.source_ko: ④ 감염병관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 3. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Infectious Disease Control Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 수인성(水因性)ㆍ식품매개감염병, 호흡기감염병, 예방접종대상 감염병 및 바이러스성 간염(이하 “수인성식품매개감염병등”이라 한다)에 대한 예방 및 관리 계획의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of prevention and management plans for waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, respiratory infectious diseases, vaccination-preventable infectious diseases, and viral hepatitis (hereinafter referred to as “waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 수인성식품매개감염병등에 관한 조사ㆍ연구의 기획 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and coordination of investigations and research on waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 수인성식품매개감염병등에 관한 감시ㆍ관리ㆍ역학조사ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 3. Surveillance, management, epidemiological investigation, and research on waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 수인성식품매개감염병등에 관한 통계 관리 및 분석
rows.text_en: 4. Statistical Management and Analysis of Waterborne and Foodborne Infectious Diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 질병대응센터의 수인성식품매개감염병등에 관한 역학조사 기술지도 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Technical guidance and evaluation of epidemiological investigations regarding waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc. by the Disease Control Center

rows.source_ko: 6. 수인성식품매개감염병등 표본감시 의료기관의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of medical institutions for sample surveillance of waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 수인성식품매개감염병등에 관한 교육ㆍ홍보 및 국제협력
rows.text_en: 7. Education, public relations, and international cooperation regarding waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 수인성식품매개감염병등에 관한 관리지침 개발 및 보급
rows.text_en: 8. Development and dissemination of management guidelines regarding waterborne and foodborne infectious diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 인수공통감염병관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Zoonotic Disease Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 인수(人獸)공통감염병, 모기매개 감염병, 진드기 매개 감염병, 설치류 매개 감염병 및 기생충감염병(이하 “인수공통감염병등”이라 한다)에 관한 예방ㆍ관리 계획 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of prevention and management plans for zoonotic diseases, mosquito-borne diseases, tick-borne diseases, rodent-borne diseases, and parasitic diseases (hereinafter referred to as “zoonotic diseases, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 인수공통감염병등에 관한 감시 및 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Surveillance and Management of Zoonotic Diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 인수공통감염병등에 관한 조사ㆍ연구 및 역학조사
rows.text_en: 3. Investigation, research, and epidemiological investigation regarding zoonotic diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 인수공통감염병등에 관한 예방관리 지침 개발 및 보급
rows.text_en: 4. Development and dissemination of prevention and management guidelines regarding zoonotic diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 인수공통감염병등에 관한 교육ㆍ홍보 및 국제협력
rows.text_en: 5. Education, public relations, and international cooperation regarding zoonotic diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 기생충감염병 표본감시 의료기관의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of Medical Institutions for Parasitic Infectious Disease Sample Surveillance

rows.source_ko: 7. 인수공통감염 전문위원회 등 인수공통감염병등과 관련한 위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of committees related to zoonotic diseases, such as the Expert Committee on Zoonotic Infections

rows.source_ko: 8. 말라리아ㆍ기생충감염병 치료용 비축의약품 구매 및 공급 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Management of Purchase and Supply of Stockpiled Medicines for the Treatment of Malaria and Parasitic Infections

rows.source_ko: 9. 인수공통감염병 등 범부처 감염병 통합관리시스템 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the inter-agency integrated infectious disease management system, including zoonotic diseases

rows.source_ko: 10. 질병대응센터의 인수공통감염병등에 관한 역학조사 기술지도 및 평가
rows.text_en: 10. Technical guidance and evaluation of epidemiological investigations regarding zoonotic diseases, etc. by the Disease Control Center

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 결핵정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 3. 28., 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Tuberculosis Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 28, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the enactment and amendment of laws and regulations related to tuberculosis

rows.text_en: 3. Composition and Operation of the Tuberculosis Expert Committee

rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of surveillance, management, epidemiological investigation, and research on tuberculosis

rows.source_ko: 6. 결핵 진단시약 및 치료제의 관리ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 6. Management and Support of Tuberculosis Diagnostic Reagents and Treatments

rows.source_ko: 7. 결핵 및 잠복결핵감염 검진사업 및 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the screening program and management of tuberculosis and latent tuberculosis infection

rows.source_ko: 8. 결핵환자 치료 및 관리 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for the treatment and management of tuberculosis patients

rows.source_ko: 9. 결핵 역학조사ㆍ접촉자 검진 기준 설정 및 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of Standards and Technology Development for Tuberculosis Epidemiological Investigation and Contact Tracing

rows.source_ko: 10. 질병대응센터의 결핵 역학조사 및 환자 관리 등에 대한 기술지도 및 평가
rows.text_en: 10. Technical guidance and evaluation of the Disease Control Center's tuberculosis epidemiological investigation and patient management, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 결핵통합관리시스템 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment and Operation of the Integrated Tuberculosis Management System

rows.source_ko: 12. 결핵예방에 관한 교육ㆍ홍보 및 국제협력
rows.text_en: 12. Education, public relations, and international cooperation regarding tuberculosis prevention

rows.source_ko: 13. 국립결핵병원의 지원 및 육성
rows.text_en: 13. Support and Development of the National Tuberculosis Hospital

rows.source_ko: 14. 결핵 관련 법인 및 단체 지원
rows.text_en: 14. Support for Tuberculosis-Related Corporations and Organizations

rows.source_ko: 15. 한센병 관련 정책 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 15. Establishment and Implementation of Policies Related to Hansen's Disease

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 에이즈관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 3. 28., 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the AIDS Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 28, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 후천성면역결핍증 관련 법령 제ㆍ개정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the enactment and amendment of laws and regulations related to Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome

rows.source_ko: 2. 후천성면역결핍증 전문위원회 구성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 2. Composition and Operation of the Expert Committee on Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome

rows.source_ko: 3. 성매개감염병ㆍ인체면역결핍바이러스감염증ㆍ후천성면역결핍증 및 엠폭스(MPOX)(이하 “성매개감염병등”이라 한다) 관련 정책 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and implementation of policies related to sexually transmitted infections, Human Immunodeficiency Virus infection, Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome, and MPOX (hereinafter referred to as “sexually transmitted infections, etc.”)

rows.source_ko: 4. 성매개감염병등의 역학조사 기준 설정 및 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of Epidemiological Investigation Standards and Technology Development for Sexually Transmitted Infections, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 질병대응센터의 성매개감염병등의 역학조사에 대한 기술지도 및 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Technical guidance and evaluation of the Disease Control Center's epidemiological investigation of sexually transmitted diseases, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 성매개감염병등 감시ㆍ관리ㆍ역학조사ㆍ연구 및 통계관리
rows.text_en: 6. Surveillance, management, epidemiological investigation, research, and statistical management of sexually transmitted infections, etc.

rows.source_ko: 7. 성매개감염병등 통합관리시스템 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and Operation of an Integrated Management System for Sexually Transmitted Infections, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 성매개감염병등의 조기발견ㆍ치료 및 관리 지원
rows.text_en: 8. Support for early detection, treatment, and management of sexually transmitted infections, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 성매개감염병등에 관한 교육ㆍ홍보 및 국제 협력
rows.text_en: 9. Education, public relations, and international cooperation regarding sexually transmitted infections, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 성매개감염병등 관련 법인 및 단체 지원
rows.text_en: 10. Support for corporations and organizations related to sexually transmitted infections, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 성매개감염병 표본감시 의료기관 관리
rows.text_en: 11. Management of Sexually Transmitted Infection (STI) Sample Surveillance Medical Institutions

rows.source_ko: 제10조(감염병위기관리국) ① 감염병위기관리국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Infectious Disease Crisis Management Bureau) ① The Director of the Infectious Disease Crisis Management Bureau shall be appointed from among general or research public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 감염병위기관리국에 위기관리총괄과ㆍ검역정책과ㆍ의료대응지원과ㆍ비축물자관리과 및 신종감염병대응과를 두되, 위기관리총괄과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 검역정책과장ㆍ의료대응지원과장ㆍ비축물자관리과장 및 신종감염병대응과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② The Infectious Disease Crisis Management Bureau shall have the Crisis Management General Division, Quarantine Policy Division, Medical Response Support Division, Stockpile Management Division, and Emerging Infectious Disease Response Division; provided that the Head of the Crisis Management General Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Health Research Officer, and the Heads of the Quarantine Policy Division, Medical Response Support Division, Stockpile Management Division, and Emerging Infectious Disease Response Division shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Health Research Officer. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 위기관리총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Crisis Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 14, 2024; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 감염병 위기관리 총괄 및 종합 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and comprehensive management of infectious disease crisis management

rows.source_ko: 2. 감염병 위기관리 대책 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of Infectious Disease Crisis Management Measures

rows.source_ko: 3. 감염병 위기관리 지침 및 매뉴얼 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Infectious Disease Crisis Management Guidelines and Manuals

rows.source_ko: 9. 검역감염병 등에 관한 예방ㆍ홍보 및 교육ㆍ훈련

rows.source_ko: 제11조(진단분석국) ① 진단분석국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Diagnostic Analysis Bureau) ① The Director of the Diagnostic Analysis Bureau shall be appointed from among general or research public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position is Grade B. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 진단분석국에 진단관리총괄과ㆍ세균분석과ㆍ바이러스분석과ㆍ매개체분석과ㆍ고위험병원체분석과ㆍ신종병원체분석과 및 생물안전평가과를 두되, 진단관리총괄과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 세균분석과장ㆍ바이러스분석과장ㆍ매개체분석과장ㆍ고위험병원체분석과장ㆍ신종병원체분석과장 및 생물안전평가과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② The Diagnostic Analysis Bureau shall have the General Diagnostic Management Division, the Bacteriological Analysis Division, the Viral Analysis Division, the Vector Analysis Division, the High-Risk Pathogen Analysis Division, the Emerging Pathogen Analysis Division, and the Biosafety Assessment Division; provided that the Head of the General Diagnostic Management Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Health Research Officer, and the Heads of the Bacteriological Analysis Division, Viral Analysis Division, Vector Analysis Division, High-Risk Pathogen Analysis Division, Emerging Pathogen Analysis Division, and Biosafety Assessment Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Health Research Officer. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호 및 제2호와 관련된 병원체에 대한 국가표준실험의 수행
rows.text_en: 3. Performance of national standard experiments on pathogens related to Nos. 1 and 2

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 신종병원체분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Novel Pathogen Analysis Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신종ㆍ원인불명 감염병에 관한 진단검사 및 병원체 감시

rows.text_en: 2. Diagnostic testing and pathogen surveillance regarding human infections of influenza and avian influenza

rows.source_ko: 3. 호흡기바이러스 감염증에 관한 진단검사 및 병원체 감시
rows.text_en: 3. Diagnostic testing and pathogen surveillance for respiratory viral infections

rows.source_ko: 4. 감염병 병원체 유전자정보 통합 데이터베이스 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of an Integrated Database of Infectious Disease Pathogen Gene Information

rows.source_ko: 5. 감염병 진단실험 국가표준품 개발 및 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Development and Support of National Standards for Infectious Disease Diagnostic Tests

rows.source_ko: 6. 신종ㆍ원인불명감염병 진단검사 및 병원체 감시ㆍ분석을 위한 국내외 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning domestic and international cooperation for diagnostic testing of emerging and unknown infectious diseases and for pathogen surveillance and analysis

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제3호까지의 사항과 관련된 병원체에 관한 국가표준실험의 수행
rows.text_en: 7. Performance of national standard experiments concerning pathogens related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 3

rows.source_ko: 8. 제1호부터 제3호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제의 개발ㆍ평가 및 보급
rows.text_en: 8. Development, evaluation, and distribution of diagnostic agents related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 3.

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 생물안전평가과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2024. 5. 14., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Biosafety Assessment Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established May 14, 2024; December 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 유전자변형생물체의 인체위해성 심사 및 평가
rows.text_en: 1. Assessment and Evaluation of Human Health Risks of Genetically Modified Organisms

rows.source_ko: 2. 생물안전(고위험병원체 등 감염병병원체 및 유전자변형생물체와 관련하여 사람에 대한 위해를 방지하는 것을 말한다. 이하 같다) 밀폐시설의 허가 및 안전관리
rows.text_en: 2. Biosafety (referring to preventing harm to humans in relation to infectious disease pathogens, such as high-risk pathogens, and genetically modified organisms; hereinafter the same applies) Permitting and Safety Management of Confined Facilities

rows.text_en: 4. Development and Research of Risk Assessment Technologies for Novel Pathogens

rows.source_ko: 5. 생물안전성 관련 정보의 수집 및 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Collection and Operation of Biosafety-Related Information

rows.source_ko: 6. 고위험병원체 등 감염병병원체의 안전관리
rows.text_en: 6. Safety Management of Infectious Disease Pathogens, Including High-Risk Pathogens

rows.source_ko: 7. 실험동물의 수급 및 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Supply and Management of Laboratory Animals

rows.text_en: 8. Research on laboratory biosafety of pathogenic microorganisms

rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning animal experiment ethics, laboratory safety, and biosafety management within the Agency
[Title amended May 14, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(의료안전예방국) ① 의료안전예방국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Medical Safety and Prevention Bureau) ① The Director of the Medical Safety and Prevention Bureau shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 의료안전예방국에 예방접종정책과ㆍ예방접종관리과ㆍ백신수급과ㆍ의료감염관리과 및 항생제내성관리과를 두되, 예방접종정책과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 예방접종관리과장ㆍ백신수급과장ㆍ의료감염관리과장 및 항생제내성관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② The Medical Safety and Prevention Bureau shall establish the Immunization Policy Division, the Immunization Management Division, the Vaccine Supply and Demand Division, the Healthcare Infection Control Division, and the Antimicrobial Resistance Control Division; provided that the Head of the Immunization Policy Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Research Officer for Public Health, and the Heads of the Immunization Management Division, the Vaccine Supply and Demand Division, the Healthcare Infection Control Division, and the Antimicrobial Resistance Control Division shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Research Officer for Public Health. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 예방접종정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Vaccination Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 예방접종 전략 및 중장기 접종계획 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of vaccination strategy and mid-to-long-term vaccination plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 예방접종 사업 관련 법령의 제정ㆍ개정 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the enactment, amendment, and operation of laws and regulations related to the vaccination program

rows.source_ko: 3. 예방접종 사업 관련 국제협력
rows.text_en: 3. International cooperation regarding vaccination programs

rows.source_ko: 4. 예방접종 후 이상반응 관련 국내외 동향 파악 및 안전성 연구 수행
rows.text_en: 4. Identify domestic and international trends regarding adverse reactions after vaccination and conduct safety studies

rows.source_ko: 5. 예방접종 후 이상반응의 감시ㆍ역학조사 및 지방자치단체의 역학조사반 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Surveillance of adverse reactions after vaccination, epidemiological investigation, and support for local government epidemiological investigation teams

rows.source_ko: 6. 예방접종 피해조사 및 국가보상제도 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Investigation of Vaccination Injuries and Operation of the National Compensation System

rows.source_ko: 7. 예방접종피해보상 전문위원회 및 예방접종피해조사반의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of the Expert Committee on Vaccination Injury Compensation and the Vaccination Injury Investigation Team

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ④ 예방접종관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Vaccination Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 예방접종사업 실시 및 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Implementation and Operation of Vaccination Program

rows.source_ko: 2. 예방접종 실시 기준 및 방법 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Vaccination Implementation Standards and Methods

rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and operation of an effectiveness evaluation system for the introduction of vaccinations

rows.source_ko: 4. 예방접종 등록자료 관리 및 활용
rows.text_en: 4. Management and Utilization of Vaccination Registration Data

rows.source_ko: 5. 예방접종 교육 및 대국민 홍보
rows.text_en: 5. Vaccination Education and Public Awareness

rows.source_ko: 6. 예방접종통합관리시스템의 구축ㆍ운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment, Operation, and Management of the Integrated Vaccination Management System

rows.source_ko: 7. 예방접종 전문위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of the Vaccination Expert Committee

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 백신수급과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Vaccine Supply and Demand Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 예방접종 백신 수급계획의 수립ㆍ조정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment, coordination, and management of vaccination vaccine supply plans

rows.text_en: 3. Vaccination Vaccine Purchase Contracts and Procurement

rows.source_ko: 4. 예방접종 백신 비축계획 수립 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Operation of Vaccine Stockpiling Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 예방접종 백신 안전관리 체계 구축 및 점검
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and Inspection of Vaccination Vaccine Safety Management System

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 의료감염관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Healthcare Infection Control Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 의료관련감염 예방ㆍ관리에 관한 계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of plans for the prevention and control of healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 2. 의료관련감염 감시체계 운영 계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and coordination of the operation plan for the healthcare-associated infection surveillance system

rows.source_ko: 3. 의료관련감염 예방ㆍ관리를 위한 의료기관 감염관리 실태조사ㆍ지도ㆍ점검 및 기술지원
rows.text_en: 3. Surveys, guidance, inspections, and technical support for infection control practices in medical institutions for the prevention and management of healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 4. 의료관련감염 예방ㆍ관리 전문인력 양성 및 교육
rows.text_en: 4. Training and education of specialized personnel for the prevention and management of healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 5. 의료관련감염 예방ㆍ관리를 위한 표준지침의 개발 및 확산
rows.text_en: 5. Development and dissemination of standard guidelines for the prevention and management of healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 6. 의료관련감염 예방ㆍ관리 홍보 및 국제협력
rows.text_en: 6. Promotion of Prevention and Control of Healthcare-Associated Infections and International Cooperation

rows.source_ko: 7. 의료관련감염에 관한 감시ㆍ역학조사ㆍ관리 및 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Surveillance, epidemiological investigation, management, and research on healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 8. 의료관련감염병 표본감시 기관의 관리 및 사업
rows.text_en: 8. Management and Operations of Healthcare-Associated Infectious Disease Sample Surveillance Institutions

rows.source_ko: 9. 의료관련감염 자율보고 운영
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of Voluntary Reporting of Healthcare-Associated Infections

rows.source_ko: 10. 국내 패혈증 환자 조사 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning the investigation of domestic sepsis patients, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 항생제내성관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Antibiotic Resistance Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 항생제 내성 예방관리 사업 계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of antibiotic resistance prevention and control program plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 항생제 내성 관련 민ㆍ관 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning public-private cooperation regarding antibiotic resistance

rows.source_ko: 3. 항생제 사용 실태조사 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Survey on Antibiotic Use and Management

rows.source_ko: 4. 항생제 사용지침 개발 및 보급
rows.text_en: 4. Development and dissemination of antibiotic use guidelines

rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning international cooperation on antibiotic resistance
⑧ Deleted <May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(만성질환관리국) ① 만성질환관리국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Chronic Disease Management Bureau) ① The Director of the Chronic Disease Management Bureau shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 「질병관리청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제16조제1항에 따라 만성질환관리국장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 건강위해대응관으로 하며, 건강위해대응관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory body placed under the Director of the Chronic Disease Control Bureau shall be the Health Risk Response Officer, and the Health Risk Response Officer shall be appointed from among general or research civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 건강위해대응관은 「질병관리청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제16조제3항제12호부터 제21호까지의 사항에 관하여 국장을 보좌한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General for Health Risk Response assists the Director General with respect to matters under Article 16, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 12 through 21 of the “Organizational Structure of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies.” <Amended May 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 만성질환관리국에 만성질환관리과, 만성질환예방과, 희귀질환관리과, 건강영양조사분석과, 손상예방정책과, 기후보건ㆍ건강위해대비과 및 의료방사선건강관리과를 두되, 만성질환관리과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 만성질환예방과장, 희귀질환관리과장, 건강영양조사분석과장, 손상예방정책과장 및 기후보건ㆍ건강위해대비과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하며, 의료방사선건강관리과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 공업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2024. 5. 14., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Chronic Disease Management Bureau shall establish the Chronic Disease Management Division, the Chronic Disease Prevention Division, the Rare Disease Management Division, the Health and Nutrition Survey and Analysis Division, the Injury Prevention Policy Division, the Climate, Health and Health Risk Preparedness Division, and the Medical Radiation Health Management Division; provided that the Head of the Chronic Disease Management Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Research Officer for Health; the Heads of the Chronic Disease Prevention Division, the Rare Disease Management Division, the Health and Nutrition Survey and Analysis Division, the Injury Prevention Policy Division, and the Climate, Health and Health Risk Preparedness Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, or Research Officer for Health; and the Head of the Medical Radiation Health Management Division shall be appointed as Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Research Officer for Health, or Research Officer for Industry. <Amended May 14, 2024; December 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(원장) 원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Director) The Director shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: 제15조(연구기획조정부) ① 연구기획조정부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Department of Research Planning and Coordination) ① The Head of the Department of Research Planning and Coordination shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 연구기획조정부에 연구기획과ㆍ생명과학연구기반과ㆍ재생의료안전관리과 및 운영지원과를 두되, 연구기획과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로, 생명과학연구기반과장 및 운영지원과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로, 재생의료안전관리과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Research Planning and Coordination Department shall have the Research Planning Division, the Life Science Research Infrastructure Division, the Regenerative Medicine Safety Management Division, and the Operations Support Division; provided that the Head of the Research Planning Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director-General, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Research Officer for Health; the Heads of the Life Science Research Infrastructure Division and the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, or Research Officer for Health; and the Head of the Regenerative Medicine Safety Management Division shall be appointed as Secretary for Science and Technology or Research Officer for Health. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 6. 청 내 기관생명윤리위원회 운영

rows.source_ko: 9. 연구원 정보화 네트워크 관리, 정보 보안 및 사무기기 운영 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the management of the research institute's information network, information security, and operation of office equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 공동기기실 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Operation and Management of the Shared Equipment Room

rows.source_ko: 11. 연구원 내 생물안전 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning biosafety management within the research institute

rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and Operation of Advanced Regenerative Medicine Clinical Research Information System

rows.source_ko: 6. 첨단재생의료 임상연구 안전관리 교육 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 6. Education and Promotion of Safety Management in Advanced Regenerative Medicine Clinical Research

rows.text_en: 3. Management of Security, Documents, Official Seals, Official Seal Registers, and Records

rows.text_en: 4. Contracts for Goods, Operation, Construction, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(미래의료연구부) ① 미래의료연구부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Future Medical Research Department) ① The Head of the Future Medical Research Department shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 미래의료연구부에 바이오빅데이터과ㆍ바이오뱅크과ㆍ유전체역학과ㆍ유전체연구기술개발과 및 헬스케어인공지능연구과를 두되, 바이오빅데이터과장 및 바이오뱅크과장은 과학기술서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 유전체역학과장ㆍ유전체연구기술개발과장 및 헬스케어인공지능연구과장은 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Future Medical Research shall have the Bio Big Data Division, Biobank Division, Genomic Epidemiology Division, Genomic Research & Technology Development Division, and Healthcare Artificial Intelligence Research Division; provided that the heads of the Bio Big Data Division and the Biobank Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology or Research Officer for Public Health, and the heads of the Genomic Epidemiology Division, Genomic Research & Technology Development Division, and Healthcare Artificial Intelligence Research Division shall be appointed as Research Officers for Public Health. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 바이오빅데이터과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Bio Big Data Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 바이오빅데이터 구축 기술 개발 및 활용
rows.text_en: 1. Development and Utilization of Bio Big Data Construction Technology

rows.source_ko: 2. 보건의료ㆍ의과학 분야 연구데이터 등록ㆍ기탁 및 분양ㆍ활용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the registration, deposit, distribution, and utilization of research data in the fields of health care and medical science

rows.source_ko: 3. 보건의료ㆍ의과학 분야 정보 및 지식의 수집ㆍ보존 및 제공

rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Operation of Data Management Information Systems in the Fields of Health and Medical Science

rows.source_ko: 5. 바이오빅데이터 개인정보 익명화 및 연계체계 구축
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of an Anonymization and Linkage System for Personal Information in Bio Big Data

rows.source_ko: 6. 보건의료연구자원정보센터 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Operation and Management of the Health and Medical Research Resource Information Center

rows.source_ko: 7. 국립의과학지식센터 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Operation and Management of the National Center for Medical Science Knowledge

rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Biobank Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 한국인체자원은행 사업 및 한국인체자원은행 네트워크 운영ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 1. Korean Bioresource Bank Project and Operation and Management of the Korean Bioresource Bank Network

rows.text_en: 2. Collection, Storage, and Management of Human Biological Materials and Related Information by the National Central Human Bioresource Bank

rows.text_en: 4. Development of management technologies for human biological materials and related information, and dissemination of technology for the standardization of human biological material banks

rows.source_ko: 5. 인체유래물 및 관련 정보의 통합관리시스템 개발ㆍ운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the development and operation of an integrated management system for human biological materials and related information

rows.source_ko: 6. 시체 연구자원의 제공 절차 표준화 및 정보시스템의 구축ㆍ관리 및 활용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the standardization of procedures for providing cadaver research resources and the establishment, management, and utilization of information systems

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 유전체역학과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Department of Genomic Epidemiology is responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 한국인 유전체 코호트(Cohort) 조사 기획 및 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and Management of the Korean Genome Cohort Survey

rows.source_ko: 2. 코호트 역학자료 생산 및 관리에 관한 사항

rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development of Health, Disease, and Biomarkers Based on Population Characteristics

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 유전체연구기술개발과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of Genome Research and Technology Development is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 유전체 연구에 필요한 기반기술의 확보 및 지원
rows.text_en: 1. Securing and supporting foundational technologies necessary for genomic research

rows.source_ko: 2. 유전체, 후성유전체, 전사체, 대사체 및 단백체 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, metabolomic, and proteomic research

rows.source_ko: 3. 유전질환 진단 기술 개발 및 표준화
rows.text_en: 3. Development and Standardization of Genetic Disease Diagnostic Technologies

rows.source_ko: 4. 한국인 유전체 특성 및 질병 형질 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Korean Genome Characteristics and Disease Traits

rows.source_ko: 5. 유전체 연구에 대한 기획ㆍ관리 및 국내외 유전체 연구협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the planning and management of genomic research and domestic and international cooperation in genomic research

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 헬스케어인공지능연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Healthcare Artificial Intelligence Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.text_en: 5. Training on Healthcare Data Analysis and Utilization, and Internal and External Cooperation

rows.source_ko: 제17조(만성질환융복합연구부) ① 만성질환융복합연구부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Division of Chronic Disease Convergence Research) ① The Head of the Division of Chronic Disease Convergence Research shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 만성질환융복합연구부에 심혈관질환연구과, 뇌질환연구과, 내분비ㆍ신장질환연구과, 호흡기ㆍ알레르기질환연구과 및 난치성질환연구과를 두되, 심혈관질환연구과장, 뇌질환연구과장, 내분비ㆍ신장질환연구과장, 호흡기ㆍ알레르기질환연구과장 및 난치성질환연구과장은 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Convergence Research on Chronic Diseases shall have the Cardiovascular Disease Research Division, Brain Disease Research Division, Endocrine and Renal Disease Research Division, Respiratory and Allergic Disease Research Division, and Intractable Disease Research Division; provided that the heads of the Cardiovascular Disease Research Division, Brain Disease Research Division, Endocrine and Renal Disease Research Division, Respiratory and Allergic Disease Research Division, and Intractable Disease Research Division shall be appointed as Health Research Officers. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Cardiovascular Disease Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 심혈관질환의 발병원인 연구, 검사 방법 및 관리지표 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the etiology of cardiovascular disease, development of testing methods, and management indicators

rows.source_ko: 2. 심혈관질환의 예방ㆍ중재 및 관리 연구

rows.source_ko: 3. 심혈관질환에 관한 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 제공

rows.text_en: 5. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the department

rows.source_ko: ④ 뇌질환연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Brain Disease Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 치매 등 뇌신경질환의 발병 원인 연구, 검사 방법 및 관련 지표 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the causes of neurodegenerative diseases such as dementia, and development of testing methods and related indicators

rows.source_ko: 2. 뇌신경질환의 예방ㆍ중재 및 관리 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Prevention, Intervention, and Management of Neurological Diseases

rows.source_ko: 3. 뇌신경질환에 관한 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 제공

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 내분비ㆍ신장질환연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.

rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Prevention, Intervention, and Management of Alcohol-Related Chronic Diseases

rows.source_ko: 5. 신장질환의 예방ㆍ중재 및 관리 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the Prevention, Intervention, and Management of Kidney Disease

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 호흡기ㆍ알레르기질환연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 3. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Respiratory and Allergic Diseases Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 28, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 천식ㆍ만성폐쇄성폐질환 등 호흡기ㆍ알레르기질환의 발병 원인 연구, 검사 방법 및 관련 지표 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the causes of respiratory and allergic diseases, such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and development of testing methods and related indicators

rows.source_ko: 2. 호흡기ㆍ알레르기질환의 예방ㆍ중재 및 관리 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Prevention, Intervention, and Management of Respiratory and Allergic Diseases

rows.source_ko: 3. 호흡기ㆍ알레르기질환에 관한 정보의 수집ㆍ분석 및 제공
rows.text_en: 3. Collection, Analysis, and Provision of Information on Respiratory and Allergic Diseases

rows.source_ko: 4. 미세먼지 관련 만성질환의 예방ㆍ중재 및 관리 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Prevention, Intervention, and Management of Fine Dust-Related Chronic Diseases

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 난치성질환연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Intractable Disease Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 난치성질환 및 유전질환의 발병 원인 및 치료법 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the causes and treatments of intractable and genetic diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 줄기세포 관련 연구, 기술 개발, 정보수집ㆍ분석 및 제공
rows.text_en: 2. Stem cell-related research, technology development, information collection, analysis, and provision

rows.source_ko: 3. 줄기세포의 등록ㆍ관리 및 배분
rows.text_en: 3. Registration, Management, and Distribution of Stem Cells

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가줄기세포은행의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Operation and Management of the National Stem Cell Bank

rows.source_ko: 5. 국립줄기세포재생센터 운영ㆍ관리 및 세포치료제 임상연구 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Operation and management of the National Stem Cell Regeneration Center and support for clinical research on cell therapies
⑧ Deleted <December 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제2절 국립감염병연구소
rows.text_en: Section 2 National Institute of Infectious Diseases

rows.source_ko: 제18조(국립감염병연구소) ① 연구소장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (National Institute of Infectious Diseases) ① The Director of the Institute shall be appointed from among general or research officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 국립감염병연구소에 감염병연구기획총괄과, 신종바이러스연구센터, 감염병연구센터, 공공백신개발지원센터를 두되, 감염병연구기획총괄과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 신종바이러스연구센터장, 감염병연구센터장 및 공공백신개발지원센터장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The National Institute of Infectious Diseases shall establish the Division for Planning and Coordination of Infectious Disease Research, the Center for Emerging Viruses Research, the Center for Infectious Disease Research, and the Center for Supporting Public Vaccine Development; provided that the Head of the Division for Planning and Coordination of Infectious Disease Research shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, a Senior Secretary, or a Public Health Research Officer, and the Heads of the Center for Emerging Viruses Research, the Center for Infectious Disease Research, and the Center for Supporting Public Vaccine Development shall be appointed as general or research civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 감염병연구기획총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Infectious Disease Research Planning Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 감염병 연구개발 기획ㆍ조정 및 성과관리
rows.text_en: 1. Planning, Coordination, and Performance Management of Infectious Disease Research and Development

rows.source_ko: 2. 감염병 연구개발 예산 편성ㆍ조정 및 평가
rows.text_en: 2. Budgeting, Adjustment, and Evaluation of Infectious Disease Research and Development

rows.source_ko: 3. 감염병 연구개발 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for infectious disease research and development

rows.source_ko: 4. 감염병 대내외 협력 총괄 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Overall management of domestic and international cooperation on infectious diseases

rows.source_ko: 제19조(신종바이러스연구센터에 두는 과) ① 신종바이러스연구센터에 신종바이러스ㆍ매개체연구과, 급성바이러스연구과, 만성바이러스연구과 및 치료임상연구과를 두되, 각 과장은 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Divisions in the Novel Virus Research Center) ① The Novel Virus and Vector Research Division, the Acute Virus Research Division, the Chronic Virus Research Division, and the Therapeutic Clinical Research Division shall be established in the Novel Virus Research Center, and the heads of each division shall be appointed as Health Research Officers.

rows.source_ko: ② 신종바이러스ㆍ매개체연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Novel Virus and Vector Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신종 호흡기 바이러스 감염증에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on Novel Respiratory Viral Infections

rows.source_ko: 2. 출혈열바이러스, 두창 등 고위험 바이러스에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on high-risk viruses such as hemorrhagic fever viruses and smallpox

rows.source_ko: 3. 원인불명의 감염에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on infections of unknown origin

rows.source_ko: 4. 위생곤충 및 위생설치류에 대한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on sanitary insects and sanitary rodents

rows.source_ko: 5. 질병매개 곤충의 자원화 및 분류 생태학적 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Resource Utilization and Classification Ecological Study of Disease-Transmitting Insects

rows.source_ko: 6. 감염병매개체에 대한 방제 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on Control of Infectious Disease Vector

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제3호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제 및 치료제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on diagnostic agents and therapeutic agents related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 3

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 센터 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Center

rows.source_ko: ③ 급성바이러스연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Acute Virus Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인플루엔자 감염증에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on influenza infection

rows.source_ko: 2. 조류 인플루엔자 인체감염증에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Human Infection with Avian Influenza

rows.source_ko: 3. 홍역 및 급성호흡기증후군에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Measles and Acute Respiratory Syndrome

rows.source_ko: 4. 호흡기바이러스 감염증에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on respiratory viral infections

rows.source_ko: 5. 장관감염바이러스성질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on viral diseases of intestinal infection

rows.source_ko: 6. 신경계바이러스성 감염질환ㆍ신경계질환 병원체에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on Viral Infectious Diseases of the Nervous System and Pathogens of Nervous System Diseases

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제 및 치료제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on diagnostic agents and therapeutic agents related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 6

rows.source_ko: ④ 만성바이러스연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Chronic Virus Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 후천성면역결핍증 및 인간면역결핍바이러스에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome and Human Immunodeficiency Virus

rows.source_ko: 2. 바이러스성 간염에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on viral hepatitis

rows.source_ko: 3. 성매개 바이러스 감염질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on sexually transmitted virus infections

rows.source_ko: 4. 레트로바이러스 감염질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on retroviral infectious diseases

rows.source_ko: 5. 헤르페스바이러스 질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Herpesvirus Diseases

rows.source_ko: 6. 항바이러스제 내성에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on antiviral resistance

rows.source_ko: 7. 제1호부터 제6호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제 및 치료제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on diagnostic agents and therapeutic agents related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 6

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 치료임상연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Clinical Treatment Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 감염병 치료제 임상시험 정책기획 및 설계
rows.text_en: 1. Policy Planning and Design for Clinical Trials of Infectious Disease Treatments

rows.source_ko: 2. 감염병 치료제 및 후보물질 임상연구
rows.text_en: 2. Clinical trials of infectious disease treatments and candidate substances

rows.source_ko: 3. 감염병 치료제 효능평가 연구 및 표준화 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Efficacy Evaluation and Standardization Studies for Infectious Disease Treatments

rows.source_ko: 4. 치료 임상시험 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for therapeutic clinical trials

rows.source_ko: 5. 국내외 치료임상 협력
rows.text_en: 5. Domestic and International Clinical Treatment Cooperation

rows.source_ko: 6. 감염질환 코호트 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Operation and Management of Infectious Disease Cohorts

rows.source_ko: 7. 감염질환 코호트 중개연구
rows.text_en: 7. Translational Research on Infectious Disease Cohorts

rows.source_ko: 8. 항생물질 평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 8. Research on the evaluation of antibiotics

rows.source_ko: 제20조(감염병연구센터에 두는 과) ① 감염병연구센터에 세균질환연구과ㆍ인수공통감염연구과 및 약제내성연구과를 두되, 각 과장은 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Divisions in the Infectious Disease Research Center) ① The Infectious Disease Research Center shall have the Bacterial Disease Research Division, the Zoonotic Infection Research Division, and the Drug Resistance Research Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Public Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 세균질환연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of the Bacterial Disease Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 장관감염세균성질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on bacterial intestinal diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 성매개 세균에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on sexually transmitted bacteria

rows.source_ko: 3. 독소생성세균질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Toxin-Producing Bacterial Diseases

rows.source_ko: 4. 결핵균 및 호흡기감염 세균질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Mycobacterium tuberculosis and bacterial respiratory infections

rows.source_ko: 5. 고위험 세균성 병원체에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on high-risk bacterial pathogens

rows.source_ko: 6. 제1호부터 제5호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제 및 치료제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on diagnostic agents and therapeutic agents related to the matters in Nos. 1 through 5

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 센터 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Center

rows.source_ko: ③ 인수공통감염연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Zoonotic Infection Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인수공통 감염질환 및 리케치아 감염질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on zoonotic and rickettsial infectious diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 매개체 전파 세균질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on vector-borne bacterial diseases

rows.source_ko: 3. 프리온 질환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on prion diseases

rows.source_ko: 4. 열대풍토ㆍ만성토착 기생충질환 및 원충성질환 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Tropical Endemic and Chronic Indigenous Parasitic and Protozoal Diseases

rows.source_ko: 5. 병원체의 생물정보의 수집ㆍ분석ㆍ생산 및 관리에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the collection, analysis, production, and management of bioinformatics of pathogens

rows.source_ko: 6. 제1호부터 제4호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제 및 치료제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on diagnostic agents and therapeutic agents related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 4

rows.source_ko: ④ 약제내성연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Drug Resistance Research Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 항균제 내성에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on antimicrobial resistance

rows.source_ko: 2. 의료감염균에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 3. 진균감염증에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on fungal infections

rows.source_ko: 4. 항진균제 내성에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on antifungal resistance

rows.source_ko: 5. 항생물질 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the development of antibiotics

rows.source_ko: 6. 제1호부터 제4호까지의 사항과 관련된 진단제제 및 치료제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on diagnostic agents and therapeutic agents related to the matters in Subparagraphs 1 through 4

rows.source_ko: 제21조(공공백신개발지원센터에 두는 과) ① 공공백신개발지원센터에 백신연구개발총괄과ㆍ감염병백신연구과ㆍ병원체자원관리과 및 백신임상연구과를 두되, 각 과장은 보건연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Divisions in the Public Vaccine Development Support Center) ① The Public Vaccine Development Support Center shall have the Vaccine Research and Development General Division, the Infectious Disease Vaccine Research Division, the Pathogen Resource Management Division, and the Vaccine Clinical Research Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Public Health Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 백신연구개발총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Head of Vaccine Research and Development Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가 백신 연구개발 정책 기획
rows.text_en: 1. National Vaccine Research and Development Policy Planning

rows.source_ko: 2. 공공백신개발ㆍ지원 인프라 예산 및 시설 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Budget and Facility Management for Public Vaccine Development and Support Infrastructure

rows.source_ko: 3. 백신 개발 대내외 협력
rows.text_en: 3. Domestic and International Cooperation in Vaccine Development

rows.source_ko: 4. 백신 효능평가 표준화 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Standardization of vaccine efficacy evaluation work

rows.source_ko: 5. 국가 백신 개발 선도를 위한 연구 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Research support to lead national vaccine development

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 센터 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Center

rows.source_ko: ③ 감염병백신연구과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Infectious Disease Vaccine Research Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가 주요 감염병의 백신 개선 및 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the Improvement and Development of Vaccines for Major National Infectious Diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 신종 감염병의 백신 개발 및 실용화 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Vaccine Development and Commercialization for Emerging Infectious Diseases

rows.source_ko: 3. 필수 백신 자급화를 위한 연구개발 및 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Research and development and support for self-sufficiency in essential vaccines

rows.source_ko: 4. 백신 신기술 연구ㆍ개발
rows.text_en: 4. Research and development of new vaccine technologies

rows.source_ko: ④ 병원체자원관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Pathogen Resource Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 병원체자원관리종합계획 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of the Comprehensive Pathogen Resource Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 병원체자원 관련 법령에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning laws and regulations related to pathogen resources

rows.source_ko: 3. 국내 병원체자원 현황조사
rows.text_en: 3. Survey of Domestic Pathogen Resources

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가병원체자원은행의 설치 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Operation of the National Pathogen Resource Bank

rows.source_ko: 제4장 질병대응센터
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Disease Response Center

rows.source_ko: 제22조(질병대응센터) ① 센터장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. 다만, 수도권질병대응센터장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Disease Response Center) ① The Director of the Center shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, or Health Research Officers. However, the Director of the Capital Region Disease Response Center shall be appointed from among general or research civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 질병대응센터(이하 이 조에서 “센터”라 한다)에 운영지원과ㆍ감염병대응과ㆍ진단분석과 및 만성질환사업과를 두되, 운영지원과장 및 감염병대응과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 진단분석과장은 보건연구관으로 보하며, 만성질환사업과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ간호사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ사회복지사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. 다만, 수도권질병대응센터의 만성질환사업과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2024. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Disease Response Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Center”) shall have the Operations Support Division, the Infectious Disease Response Division, the Diagnostic Analysis Division, and the Chronic Disease Project Division; provided that the Heads of the Operations Support Division and the Infectious Disease Response Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Health Research Officer; the Head of the Diagnostic Analysis Division shall be appointed as Health Research Officer; and the Head of the Chronic Disease Project Division shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Industrial Officer, Health Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Nursing Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, Social Welfare Officer, or Health Research Officer. However, the Head of the Chronic Disease Project Division of the Capital Region Disease Response Center shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Health Research Officer. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 운영지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of Operations Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 센터 주요업무계획의 수립 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of the Center's major business plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 센터의 조직ㆍ정원 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the organization and staffing management of the Center

rows.source_ko: 3. 센터 및 검역소 소속직원의 상훈ㆍ교육ㆍ복무관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the awards, education, and service management of employees belonging to the Center and Quarantine Station

rows.source_ko: 4. 센터 및 검역소 소속직원 급여ㆍ연금 및 복리후생에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning salaries, pensions, and welfare benefits of employees belonging to the Center and Quarantine Station

rows.source_ko: 5. 세입ㆍ세출예산의 편성ㆍ집행ㆍ결산 등 예산 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning budget management, such as the formulation, execution, and settlement of revenue and expenditure budgets

rows.source_ko: 6. 보안 및 관인ㆍ관인대장의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Security and Management of Official Seals and Official Seal Registers

rows.source_ko: 7. 문서의 분류ㆍ수발ㆍ보존ㆍ관리 및 기록물 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the classification, dispatch, preservation, and management of documents and records management

rows.source_ko: 8. 민원사무 및 정보공개업무 제도 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the operation of civil complaint and information disclosure systems

rows.source_ko: 9. 시설ㆍ물품 등 국유재산의 관리 및 물품ㆍ용역ㆍ공사 등의 계약에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the management of state-owned property, such as facilities and goods, and contracts for goods, services, construction, etc.

rows.source_ko: 10. 센터 및 검역소의 정부비상훈련 및 그 밖에 비상계획에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning government emergency drills and other emergency plans for the Center and Quarantine Station

rows.source_ko: 11. 센터 및 검역소의 정보화 계획 수립ㆍ시행 및 정보화기기 운용ㆍ유지관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the establishment and implementation of informatization plans for the Center and Quarantine Station, and the operation and maintenance of informatization equipment

rows.source_ko: 12. 센터 및 검역소의 대외소통 및 기관 홍보 전반에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the overall external communication and institutional promotion of the Center and Quarantine Station

rows.source_ko: 13. 그 밖에 센터 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Center

rows.source_ko: ④ 감염병대응과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2024. 3. 26.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Infectious Disease Response Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Mar. 26, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관할구역 내 감염병 예방ㆍ관리 계획 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of infectious disease prevention and management plans within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 2. 관할구역 내 감염병 발생 감시, 발생정보ㆍ환자정보의 분석 및 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Surveillance of infectious disease outbreaks within the jurisdiction, and analysis and management of outbreak and patient information

rows.source_ko: 3. 「감염병 예방 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제18조에 따른 감염병 역학조사
rows.text_en: 3. Epidemiological investigation of infectious diseases pursuant to Article 18 of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Infectious Diseases

rows.source_ko: 4. 관할구역 내 지방자치단체 역학조사 기술지도
rows.text_en: 4. Technical guidance on epidemiological investigations by local governments within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 5. 관할구역 내 감염병관리기관 및 접촉자 격리시설의 관리 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for the management of infectious disease control agencies and contact isolation facilities within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 6. 「감염병 예방 및 관리에 관한 법률」제17조제1항에 따른 질병관리청장이 수행하는 감염병의 관리 및 감염 실태와 내성균 실태조사 등의 실태조사
rows.text_en: 6. Surveys on the management of infectious diseases, infection status, and status of resistant bacteria, etc., conducted by the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Infectious Diseases

rows.source_ko: 7. 의료관련감염병의 감시 및 관리 지원
rows.text_en: 7. Support for the surveillance and management of healthcare-associated infections

rows.source_ko: 8. 「의료법」제47조에 따른 의료관련감염 자율보고에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning voluntary reporting of healthcare-associated infections pursuant to Article 47 of the Medical Services Act

rows.source_ko: 9. 「결핵예방법」 제10조 및 「후천성면역결핍증 예방법」 제10조에 따라 질병관리청장이 수행하는 역학조사 및 환자ㆍ접촉자 등 관리 지원
rows.text_en: 9. Support for epidemiological investigations and management of patients, contacts, etc. conducted by the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency pursuant to Article 10 of the Tuberculosis Prevention Act and Article 10 of the Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome Prevention Act

rows.source_ko: 10. 관할구역 내 감염병 대비ㆍ대응 자원 비축 및 관리
rows.text_en: 10. Stockpiling and Management of Resources for Infectious Disease Preparedness and Response within the Jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 11. 관할구역 내에서 개최하는 대규모 국내ㆍ국제 행사 등 관련 감염병 대비ㆍ대응 계획 수립 및 현장 지원
rows.text_en: 11. Establishment of infectious disease preparedness and response plans and on-site support for large-scale domestic and international events held within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 12. 관할구역 내 검역 관련 정보 수집ㆍ분석 및 통계 산출
rows.text_en: 12. Collection and analysis of quarantine-related information and calculation of statistics within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 13. 관할구역 내 검역정보 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Management of Quarantine Information within the Jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 14. 관할구역 내 국제공인예방접종 지정기관 지도 및 감독
rows.text_en: 14. Guidance and supervision of internationally accredited vaccination centers within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 15. 관할구역 내 검역감염병의사환자 등에 대한 검역소 역학조사 지원
rows.text_en: 15. Support for epidemiological investigations by quarantine stations regarding suspected cases of quarantine infectious diseases, etc. within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 16. 관할구역 내 검역소와 지방자치단체 간 연계 위기대응훈련 기획 및 평가
rows.text_en: 16. Planning and evaluation of crisis response training linking quarantine stations and local governments within the jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 17. 감염병 유행 시 검역지원인력 및 격리시설 확보 등
rows.text_en: 17. Securing quarantine support personnel and isolation facilities, etc., in the event of an infectious disease outbreak

rows.source_ko: 18. 관할구역 내 감염병관리사업 지원기구의 지원 및 관리
rows.text_en: 18. Support and Management of Infectious Disease Control Support Organizations within the Jurisdiction

rows.source_ko: 19. 그 밖에 감염병 예방ㆍ대응 등과 관련한 지방자치단체 등 유관 기관과의 협력체계 구축ㆍ운영 및 현장 지원
rows.text_en: 19. Other matters related to the prevention and response to infectious diseases, such as establishing and operating a cooperation system with relevant organizations including local governments and providing on-site support

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 진단분석과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Diagnostic Analysis Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 검역감염병의 진단검사 및 병원체 감시
rows.text_en: 1. Diagnostic testing and pathogen surveillance of quarantine infectious diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 검역구역 내 감염병 매개체 서식 분포 등 조사
rows.text_en: 2. Investigation of the distribution of infectious disease vectors within the quarantine zone, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 검역구역 내 감염병 병원체 오염여부 확인 및 검사
rows.text_en: 3. Confirmation of and testing for infectious disease pathogen contamination within the quarantine zone

rows.source_ko: 4. 역학조사(지방자치단체에서 수행하는 역학조사는 제외한다)를 위한 진단검사
rows.text_en: 4. Diagnostic tests for epidemiological investigations (excluding epidemiological investigations conducted by local governments)

rows.source_ko: 5. 감염병 고위험군에 관한 진단검사(지방자치단체 관리 대상 감염병 고위험군은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Diagnostic testing for high-risk groups for infectious diseases (excluding high-risk groups for infectious diseases under the management of local governments)

rows.source_ko: 6. 민간 감염병 검사기관의 진단검사에 관한 기술지도 및 조정
rows.text_en: 6. Technical guidance and coordination regarding diagnostic testing by private infectious disease testing institutions
⑥ The Head of the Chronic Disease Business Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Sep. 27, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국민건강증진법」제16조제1항에 따라 질병관리청장이 실시하는 국민건강영양조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the National Health and Nutrition Survey conducted by the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the National Health Promotion Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「구강보건법」 제9조제1항에 따라 질병관리청장이 실시하는 구강건강실태조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the oral health status survey conducted by the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Oral Health Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「심뇌혈관질환법」 제6조에 따라 질병관리청장이 실시하는 심뇌혈관질환 조사통계사업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease survey and statistics project conducted by the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency pursuant to Article 6 of the Cardiovascular and Cerebrovascular Diseases Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「지역보건법」 제4조에 따라 실시하는 지역사회 건강실태조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the community health status survey conducted pursuant to Article 4 of the Regional Health Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 건강수준 지역격차 해소 지원 관련 사업
rows.text_en: 5. Projects related to supporting the reduction of regional disparities in health levels

rows.source_ko: 6. 손상 조사 및 흡연피해 예방 조사
rows.text_en: 6. Damage Investigation and Smoking Damage Prevention Investigation

rows.source_ko: 7. 건강 행태, 만성질환 및 손상 조사의 자료 질 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning data quality management for health behaviors, chronic diseases, and injuries

rows.source_ko: 8. 건강 행태, 만성질환 및 손상 조사 관련 교육프로그램 운영
rows.text_en: 8. Operation of educational programs related to health behaviors, chronic diseases, and injury surveys

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 관할구역 내 중독물질, 기후변화 등 건강위해 관련 조사 및 통계
rows.text_en: 9. Other investigations and statistics related to health hazards, such as toxic substances and climate change, within the jurisdiction

rows.text_en: ⑦ The names and jurisdictional areas of the Disease Response Centers are as shown in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제23조(국립검역소) ① 검역소장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. 다만, 국립인천공항검역소장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직 또는 연구직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (National Quarantine Stations) ① The head of a quarantine station shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Health Research Officer. However, the head of the Incheon National Airport Quarantine Station shall be appointed from among general or research civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 국립인천공항검역소에 서무과ㆍ검역1과 및 검역2과를 두고, 국립부산검역소에 서무과 및 검역과를 두며, 국립인천검역소 및 국립울산검역소에 검역과를 두되, 국립인천공항검역소의 서무과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ간호사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ사회복지사무관 또는 보건연구관으로, 검역1과장 및 검역2과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 보건연구관으로 보하고, 국립부산검역소의 서무과장ㆍ검역과장, 국립인천검역소 및 국립울산검역소의 검역과장은 공업사무관ㆍ보건사무관ㆍ의료기술사무관ㆍ약무사무관ㆍ간호사무관ㆍ시설사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ사회복지사무관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The National Incheon Airport Quarantine Station shall have a General Affairs Division, Quarantine Division 1, and Quarantine Division 2; the National Busan Quarantine Station shall have a General Affairs Division and a Quarantine Division; and the National Incheon Quarantine Station and the National Ulsan Quarantine Station shall have a Quarantine Division; wherein the Head of the General Affairs Division at the National Incheon Airport Quarantine Station shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Industrial Officer, Public Health Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Nursing Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Officer, Administrative Officer, Social Welfare Officer, or Public Health Research Officer; and the Heads of Quarantine Division 1 and Quarantine Division 2 shall be appointed as Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Public Health Research Officer; and the Heads of the General Affairs Division and Quarantine Division at the National Busan Quarantine Station, and the Heads of the Quarantine Division at the National Incheon Quarantine Station and the National Ulsan Quarantine Station They shall be appointed as Industrial Officer, Public Health Officer, Medical Technology Officer, Pharmaceutical Officer, Nursing Officer, Facilities Officer, Computer Science Officer, Administrative Officer, Social Welfare Officer, or Public Health Research Officer. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 3. 검역구역 내 보건위생관리
rows.text_en: 3. Health and hygiene management within the quarantine zone

rows.source_ko: 4. 해외감염병신고센터 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of the Overseas Infectious Disease Reporting Center

rows.source_ko: 5. 검역 통계 및 정보 관리

rows.text_en: 8. Internal and external cooperation with related organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제27조(질병관리청에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 질병관리청에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 5와 같다. 다만, 「질병관리청과 그 소속기관 직제」 제34조제1항 단서에 따라 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 정원은 별표 6과 같으며, 별표 6의 정원 중 4명(서기관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ행정사무관 또는 보건사무관 1명, 행정사무관 또는 보건사무관 1명, 행정서기ㆍ보건서기 또는 전산서기 1명, 행정서기보 또는 보건서기보 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <개정 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 3. 26., 2025. 3. 25., 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Personnel Quotas for Public Officials in the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency) ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency by rank (excluding temporary personnel quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies” ; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) are as set forth in Table 5. However,the personnel quotas for public officials determined separately within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total personnel quota pursuant to the proviso of Article 34 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies” are as set forth in Table 6 , and among the personnel quotas in Table 6 , 4 persons (1 Secretary, Secretary of Science and Technology, Administrative Officer, or Public Health Officer; 1 Administrative Officer or Public Health Officer; 1 Administrative Clerk, Public Health Clerk, or Computer Clerk; and 1 Assistant Administrative Clerk or Assistant Public Health Clerk) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023; Mar. 26, 2024; Mar. 25, 2025; Jan. 6, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 질병관리청에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 홍보업무를 담당하는 2명(7급 1명, 8급 1명), 소송업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 그 밖의 정원 중 14명(3급 또는 4급 1명, 4급 4명, 5급 4명, 6급 3명, 7급 2명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency, two persons responsible for public relations (one at Grade 7 and one at Grade 8), one person responsible for litigation (one at Grade 5), and 14 persons among the remaining authorized number (one at Grade 3 or 4, four at Grade 4, four at Grade 5, three at Grade 6, and two at Grade 7) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 질병관리청에 두는 공무원 정원 중 디지털 홍보 업무를 담당하는 1명(6급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다. <신설 2026. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ③ Among the authorized number of public officials at the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency, one person (Grade 6) responsible for digital public relations shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official. <Newly added Jan. 6, 2026>

However,the personnel quota by rank for public officials, separately determined within a range not exceeding 10 percent of the total quota pursuant to the proviso of Article 35, Paragraph 1 of the "Organizational Structure of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies ," shall be as set forth in Table 7-2 ; and two of the personnel quota set forth in Table 7-2 (two Assistant Administrative Clerks or Assistant Public Health Clerks) shall be appointed as fixed-term public officials. <Amended May 11, 2021; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정원에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행으로 감축되는 국립마산병원의 정원 2명(7급 1명, 8급 1명)과 국립목포병원의 정원 1명(7급 1명)에 해당하는 초과현원이 있는 경우에는 그 초과된 현원이 이 규칙 시행에 따른 정원과 일치될 때까지 그에 상응하는 정원이 국립마산병원과 국립목포병원에 각각 따로 있는 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Staffing Quotas)  In the event that there is an excess of personnel corresponding to the quota of 2 positions (1 Grade 7 and 1 Grade 8) at Masan National Hospital and 1 position (1 Grade 7) at Mokpo National Hospital that are reduced by the enforcement of this Rule, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to exist separately at Masan National Hospital and Mokpo National Hospital, respectively, until the excess personnel match the quota pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule.
